chapters.title: From Marine Corps satcom to Microsoft cloud
Why identity is the new perimeter
Common mistakes with privileged accounts and Zero Trust
How Intune and Entra ID complement each other
PowerShell, automation and learning with AI

takeaways: Protect the identity plane first: move to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication before investing in advanced device compliance or AI.
Entra PIM replaces standing admin rights with just-in-time, task-driven elevation, ideally with justifications, approvals and authentication context that forces MFA on every activation.
Combining Intune device compliance, device filtering and Conditional Access with cloud-only admin accounts creates defense in depth, and PowerShell keeps admins working when portals fail.
hook: Attackers rarely break in anymore, they sign in, and over-privileged admin accounts make that easy. In this episode Microsoft MVP Mark Orr shows Microsoft 365 and security admins how Entra Privileged Identity Management, phishing-resistant MFA, Intune device compliance and Conditional Access work together, and how PowerShell automation makes just-in-time access practical.
